verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a locally installed CLI that stores caches, installs and config, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented retention settings, deletion or purge commands, or data-lifecycle controls. The env-var unloading line ('Set when you enter, gone when you leave') describes shell environment scoping, not data retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
